_doc: Website interface text in English, the default language. Every other i18n/<code>.json needs the same keys in "ui" with the same {placeholders}. Keys ending in _html may hold HTML. See AGENTS.md > Languages.

ui.form_sent: Thanks! Your message is on its way. We'll reply by email.
ui.form_err_captcha: The spam check didn't pass. Please wait for it to finish and try again.
ui.form_err_fields: Please add a valid email address and a message.
ui.form_err_send: Sorry, that didn't send. Please try again in a moment.
ui.form_err_offline: Sorry, that didn't send. Check your connection and try again.
ui.legal_desc: Licences, credits and privacy policies for {studio} games.
ui.legal_thanks: Thank you to everyone whose work helps make our games. Each game also shows its full licence texts in its own Credits screen.
ui.legal_trademarks: Game names, logos and screenshots are the property of {studio}. Google Play and the Google Play logo are trademarks of Google LLC.
ui.site_privacy_html:
Privacy. This site runs no analytics or ads. Its only cookie remembers the language you pick in the menu at the top, and only once you pick one. Fonts and images are served from this site. Links to stores and other sites follow those sites' own policies.

Language. When you first arrive, the site uses your country (from your connection) and your browser's language to choose which language to show. Nothing about this is stored.
ui.site_form_html: Contact form. When you send the form, your name, email address and message are emailed to us so we can reply, and are kept only in our inbox. Nothing is stored on the website. The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to stop spam, which loads a script from Cloudflare and checks your browser (Cloudflare privacy policy). Ask us any time to delete your messages.
ui.site_noform_html: Nothing is loaded from other servers unless you play a trailer.
ui.site_trailers_html: Trailers. A game page shows its trailer as a picture from this site. Only when you press play does the video load from YouTube in its privacy-enhanced mode (Google privacy policy).
